## Appearance

Shirley is a red-headed schoolteacher with a pointed chin and wonderful eyes. Her ruddy hair is worn in a long braid or arranged in smooth ripples, and her nose is noticeably freckled.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P24](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0024), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027), [v3 ch.Life P38](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0038)_

## History

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia). After spending her early childhood as an orphan, she was taken in by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). She excelled academically, earning the Avery Scholarship, but opted to stay local as a schoolteacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to remain with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) following Matthew's death. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) arranged for [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could resign her teaching post and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). During her time in college, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refused [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's desire to take their relationship beyond friendship, and she subsequently began a romantic courtship with a fellow student named Royal Gardner. After returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a stay, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was devastated to learn that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) was critically ill with typhoid fever, a crisis that led her to realize her true feelings for him shortly before learning he would recover.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P16](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P17](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0017), +18 more_

## Quotes

> "In the years to come thy memory will shine like a star over my lonely life, as that last story we read together says. Diana, wilt thou give me a lock of thy jet-black tresses in parting to treasure forevermore?"
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010)

> "Fare thee well, my beloved friend. Henceforth we must be as strangers though living side by side. But my heart will ever be faithful to thee."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P12](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0012)

> "That is all there is left in life for me, now that my friend has been ruthlessly torn from me. In school I can look at her and muse over days departed."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017)

> “I think he has only been its nominal head for many years,” said Anne. “He is a very old man; his nephews are really at the head of the institution.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P35](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0035)

> “If I had been the boy you sent for,” said Anne wistfully, “I’d be able to help you so much now and spare you in a hundred ways. I could find it in my heart to wish I had been, just for that.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) initially established a fierce academic rivalry while attending school together. Though they celebrated individual scholastic triumphs and eventually shared quiet, romantic moments as they grew older, their bond became strained when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejected Gilbert's desire to take their relationship beyond friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +9 more_

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) share a warm, friendly bond built on mutual affection and trust. They frequently spend time together picking berries and preparing [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for visits and special occasions, with [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) confiding her worries about Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--shirley.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's close childhood friend, having sworn eternal friendship even through periods when they were temporarily forced apart. They remain constant companions who support each other through major life milestones, including teaching resignations, engagements, and wedding preparations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +29 more_

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) enjoy a close friendship marked by frequent visits to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) actively supports [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) by staying to cheer her up during periods of despondency, assisting with her wedding preparations, and visiting her during summer breaks to share personal confidences.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), +21 more_

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) serves as both a mentor and a friend to [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), who was one of her imaginative students during her time teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. Their bond is rooted in mutual affection, with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) offering gifts and sharing his imaginative writings, while continuing to visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) even after she resigns her teaching position.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), +36 more_
